title: Ontario single-household welfare-income adequacy: 2020 and 2024 historical snapshots
purpose: Historical course visualization. Separate model-household snapshots, not current benefit advice, observed recipient income, or a population poverty rate.
currency: Nominal CAD in the indicated calendar year; published nearest-dollar figures
plotting_rule: Show snapshots as separate panels or a year selector. Do not connect years into a trend, interpolate missing years, or describe a measured improvement/deterioration: the 2020 benchmark is a publication-vintage estimate and the snapshots are from different editions.
shared_assumptions: No employment earnings; maximum standard assistance under report assumptions
Toronto private-market rental housing, utilities included in rent
Special-needs or individually requested assistance generally excluded
interpretation: Numerator is total modeled welfare income including federal and provincial credits, not the OW or ODSP payment alone.
No eligibility coverage, take-up, unmet need, or causal policy effectiveness is estimated.
MBM is intended for disposable income but Maytree compares total transfer income; this may understate inadequacy.
Extra costs of disability are not in the shared single-person MBM. An ODSP ratio above OW does not establish better program performance.
Toronto thresholds must not be represented as a province-wide cost-of-living benchmark.
Published income and threshold levels are rounded; calculated ratios are approximate and dollar gaps can differ from the reports by one dollar.

2020.status: Maytree estimate made by uprating 2019 Toronto threshold with city CPI; official 2020 threshold unavailable at publication

2024.status: 2024 report-published 2018-base benchmark; official Statistics Canada release vintage not independently verified. The explicit CPI-estimation passage in the 2024 methodology refers to LIM, not MBM.
2024.not_back_calculated: Not derived by dividing income by a rounded adequacy percentage.

methodology_check.evidence: The paragraph states that 2024 LIM thresholds were unavailable and estimated by increasing 2023 levels in line with national CPI. The adjacent MBM-over-time section states comparisons use current MBM thresholds and 2000, 2008 and 2018 bases. Neither passage states 2024 MBM was unavailable or that it was uprated by Maytree.
methodology_check.conclusion: Do not transfer the LIM estimation statement to MBM. Retain Maytree report-published benchmark wording without claiming an independently verified official release date or final-data status.

2020.included_pandemic_payment: GST/HST one-time top-up 290 for each single household, already included in federal credits and total
excluded: CERB and CRB: model households do not meet employment-income assumptions
EI and CPP: model not eligible
Federal 600 disability payment: model households not eligible through qualifying federal programs
Ontario Emergency Benefit: separate application and fewer than half received it under report inclusion rule

2024.federal_details: Both singles: basic GST/HST credit 332.50 and Canada Carbon Rebate 542; disability example also GST/HST supplement 78.97. 2023 Grocery Rebate absent in 2024.
2024.provincial_details: Ontario Trillium Benefit. Basic ODSP increased 4.5 percent in July 2024; basic OW unchanged.
2024.rounding: Rounded displayed components sum to 10456 for OW and 17825 for ODSP, while reported totals are 10455 and 17826. Preserve the published totals; do not recalculate from rounded components.

source_anomalies: 2020 Ontario component table prints ODSP total 15665, but narrative, cross-Canada table, graph and component sum support 15655.
2020 printed OW gap and 2024 printed ODSP gap differ by one dollar from subtraction of published rounded levels. Use one transparent calculation from the stored levels.

excluded_latest_edition.reason: Latest page applies 2023-base MBM for recent years. Deliberately not merged into the 2018-base historical snapshots. The 2024 edition is not labeled latest.

download_limits: Public XLSX/PDF downloads via executor were blocked by the environment proxy. Full report/page text was read with web tools. No original workbook retrieval or full time-series reproduction is claimed.
